correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive certificate: 36 perfect matchings, 120 automorphisms, eight exact orbits covering 435 edge pairs; every representative has an explicitly acyclic full-face-poset discrete Morse matching. Exact signed integral attaching matrices are zero except one primitive rank-one matrix [[0,1],[0,-1]]. Resulting CW models contain only 2- and 3-cells and a basepoint, so the exact integral homotopy types follow. Independently calculated simplicial F2 and F3 homology agree.

value.rationale: The complete 435-pattern, eight-orbit homotopy fault spectrum identifies a sharp topological transition for a classical cubic polyhedral graph: two-edge deletions produce no torsion at all, while earlier intact and one-fault stages have Moore 2-torsion. It separates incident faults (contractible) from disjoint faults (one S2 with zero, one or two S3 summands) and provides exact multiplicities for every type. This is a motivated robustness boundary and complete exact classification, not a one-off routine count.
